events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_full $6.61 (model confidence 0.90)
events.body: The driver cancelled this RydeX trip, so the fee can only stand if the driver's no-show claim satisfies NS-1 through NS-0 [F4][NS-0]. NS-1 requires (i) an "I'm Here" tap, (ii) GPS placing the driver at the pickup at the moment of the tap, and (iii) more than 3 minutes of waiting inside the pickup radius after the tap [NS-1]. Condition (i) is met: the platform recorded arrival at 21:28:05 and the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 21:29:10 [F5][F6]. Condition (ii) is met: at the tap the driver was 42 m from the pickup point, inside the 200 m radius [F6][F1]. Condition (iii) fails. After the tap the driver remained within 200 m for only 1 min 45 s (105 s) before cancelling at 21:30:55, and total cumulative time within 200 m before cancellation was 2 min 50 s — both below the required 3:01 [F6][F2][F4][NS-1]. The driver's own chat message at 21:30 ("waited too long") and his statement claim "at least 5 minutes at the pickup", but the timeline records show arrival at 21:28:05 and cancellation at 21:30:55, i.e. at most 2 min 50 s at the pickup [F11][F12][F5][F4]; system records override these statements. Because NS-1(iii) is not fulfilled, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee must be refunded in full [F8][NS-2]. No fake tap occurred — the driver was genuinely inside the pickup radius when he tapped — so the NS-2 flag_account limb is not triggered [F6][F1][NS-2]. The refund is issued as a Ryde voucher, not cash, and Ryde retains final discretion [NS-7].

Your message and statement said you waited longer, but system records take precedence. No action is being taken against your account. Keep tapping "I'm Here" once you arrive and allow the full wait before cancelling.
